_comment: Statements on the public record about the workforce this site measures, kept verbatim with the federal figures that stand alongside them. The figures are recomputed at build time from IPEDS; only the statement and its source live here. Where a statement concerns data this site does not hold, that is noted as a limit of this site, not of the statement.

statements.speaker: Doug Burgum, US Secretary of the Interior
statements.source_note: Quoted from the video's original-language automatic caption track (en-orig), retrieved 2026-10-01. Automatic captions carry transcription errors; the wording is as captioned, and a second English track on the same video is a machine translation of a Russian dub and was not used.
